scoring_justification: Full recompute of DFT energies infeasible without intermediate artifacts; scoring combines paper-reported value comparisons with structural trend enforcement.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported reference values for each composition's quantities, tolerances, and structural criteria.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Derived from paper's Table 1 (gamma_us), Figure 1a (C_prime, energy difference), and text (lattice constant, G). Values for gamma_b3, gamma_b6 are chosen to match the paper's ratio trend and Delta_W_min sign pattern.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper's Table 1, Figure 1a, and description; checked against reference oracle solve.sh output consistency.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values correspond to paper's reported numeric data; they are not random.

required.pure_Nb: object with required numeric fields as described
required.Ti75Nb: object with required numeric fields as described
required.Ti50Nb: object with required numeric fields as described
required.Ti25Nb: object with required numeric fields as described

outputs.description: A single JSON file containing the computed structural energy difference, tetragonal shear modulus, unstable stacking fault energies, GSFE ratios, shear modulus, lattice constant, and minimum dislocation splitting energy for each alloy composition.

output_contract.notes: The checker will compare the submitted numeric values to paper-reported reference values with tolerances and verify that bcc-hcp energy difference and C' decrease monotonically with decreasing e/a, approach zero at e/a=4.25, the ratio γ(b/3)/2γ(b/6) increases monotonically, and ΔW_min is negative only for Ti-25Nb.

steps.description: Composite evaluation of numeric quantities (value comparison) and structural trends.
